items.title: Email Campaign · : Referral Push (30-60 Day Post-Install)
items.preview:
**Audience:** 27 satisfied clients, 30-60 days post-install
**Segment Name:** Referral_Push_May2026
---
### Subject Lines
**PRIMARY:**
`Quick favor (and $500 if you know someone)`
**ALTERNATES:**
1. `Your install is done. Now, the $500 question`
2. `Know anyone stuck with bad water?`
3. `2 minutes = $500 (seriously)`
4. `The easiest $500 you'll make this month`
---
### Preview Text
`If your neighbor asks about your water, here's what that conversation is worth to you.`
---
### Email Body
Hi Nicole,
Your ClearWave Sovereign + RO Pure PRO QC has been running for about six weeks now. By this point you've probably noticed the difference: clearer ice, softer laundry, no more scale on the faucets.
And someone has probably asked.
Maybe a neighbor saw the install truck. Maybe a friend asked why your water tastes different. Maybe your in-laws mentioned their own hard water nightmare.
Here's what that conversation is worth:
**If they book a free water assessment and close: $500 cash** (referrals 1-5 in the year). Referrals 6-9 pay $750. Referrals 10+ pay $1,000. Resets every January.
**If they book but don't buy: $50 gift card** for the intro.
No strings. No catch. Just text me their name and number: **(540) 412-7464**.
We'll take it from there, and you'll get paid within 7 days of their install.
Good water deserves good neighbors.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
---
### Send Timing
**Tuesday, 10:00 AM ET**
(Mid-morning on a weekday, when people are scanning email between tasks and can quickly forward a contact or text a referral.)
---
### Expected Performance
| Metric | Estimate | Justification |
|--------|----------|---------------|
| Open Rate | 48% | Highly engaged recent buyers (30-60d post-install), money hook in subject, personalized system reference in body. Current list avg is 41.2%; this segment should beat it by 15-20%. |
| Click Rate | 8% | CTA is a text action (lower friction than click), but body includes implicit "forward this" behavior. Expect 2-3 actual referrals generated. |
| Conversion | 2-3 referrals submitted | 27 recipients × 8% engagement = ~2 referrals. Historical referral close rate ~40%, so 1 likely closed deal = $500 payout + $3k-8k revenue. |
---
### Source Justification
**IDEA_SOURCING.md anchors:**
- **§ Lifecycle trigger: "Referral push (30-60d post-install)"**. Exact match to this campaign.
- **§ Killing_Bad_Water_Sales register: "Closed mouths don't get fed"**. The referral ask is direct, zero apology.
- **§ Voice: "Parallel structure, triadic closes"**. "Good water deserves good neighbors" is the single-sentence close.
- **§ Referral bonus structure (hard rule)**. $500 / $750 / $1,000 tier structure used verbatim, $50 for non-close referrals cited.
---

items.title: Email Campaign · : 1-Year Annual Service Reminder
items.preview:
**Audience:** 20 clients at 1-year post-install (minus CWWS Shop & Storage internal account = 19 viable)
**Segment Name:** Annual_Service_May2026
---
### Subject Lines
**PRIMARY:**
`Your Iron Pure is 1 year old this week`
**ALTERNATES:**
1. `Time for your annual service (here's why)`
2. `1 year down. 19 to go.`
3. `Your system earned its checkup`
4. `The 12-month question: how's your water?`
---
### Preview Text
`Twelve months in, your system has moved thousands of gallons. Here's what happens next.`
---
### Email Body
Hi Edward,
Your Iron Pure hit its first birthday this week.
Over the past twelve months, it has processed roughly 32,000 gallons of water. Removed iron, sediment, and hardness. Kept your fixtures clean and your water soft.
It has earned its annual service.
Here's what we check:
**Resin bed condition.** Brine tank levels. Valve cycle timing. Bypass and drain line integrity. We'll swap any filter media that's due, recalibrate if needed, and confirm everything is dialed in for year two.
Most systems run flawlessly between annual services. But small adjustments now prevent big problems later.
**Your annual service is included if you're on Concierge. If you're on pay-as-you-go, it's $149.**
Ready to book? Reply to this email or text me: **(540) 412-7464**.
We'll get you on the calendar within the next two weeks.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
---
### Send Timing
**Thursday, 9:00 AM ET**
(Early week = too rushed, Friday = gets buried. Thursday morning is the "get organized for next week" window, and service bookings feel like responsible homeowner admin.)
---
### Expected Performance
| Metric | Estimate | Justification |
|--------|----------|---------------|
| Open Rate | 52% | Personalized subject (actual product + time trigger), high relevance (system maintenance), trusted sender (CEO, post-purchase relationship). Should beat list avg by ~25%. |
| Click Rate | 2% | No clickable CTA in email (reply or text), so click metric is irrelevant. Measure reply/text rate instead. |
| Conversion | 8-10 service bookings | 19 viable recipients × 50% engagement × 80% booking rate = 7-8 bookings. Add 1-2 who book without replying (call direct). Avg service revenue $149 × 8 = ~$1,200. Concierge upsell discussions will happen naturally on these calls. |
---
### Source Justification
**IDEA_SOURCING.md anchors:**
- **§ Lifecycle trigger: "1-year annual service candidates"**. Exact match to Jobber trigger data (20 candidates this week).
- **§ Hard Rule #1: "NEVER pitch Concierge before 1 year post-install"**. This email does NOT pitch Concierge, it offers the annual service (which is the gateway to Concierge conversations, but occurs naturally during the service call, not in this email).
- **§ Hard Rule #2: Product naming**. "Your Iron Pure" (actual system from Jobber data) used in subject + personalized in body for Edward Ryan.
- **§ Luxury_product register: "Engineered for purity," "uncompromising," minimal tone**. Body copy is factual, confident, no hype. "It has earned its annual service" = luxury framing (the product deserves care, not "you should probably get this done").
- **§ Triadic structure**. "Removed iron, sediment, and hardness. Kept your fixtures clean and your water soft." / "Small adjustments now prevent big problems later."
---
## Why These Two (and Not the Others)
**Concierge Upsell (100 candidates, 13-24mo post-install):**
Strong revenue potential ($99/mo × 10 conversions = $1k MRR), BUT: this segment is cold (no recent touchpoint), and Concierge is a *retention* play, not a *revenue spike* play. Better as a **Week 2 or Week 3** campaign after we've re-engaged the annual service audience (who will naturally ask about Concierge during their service calls). The annual service email above *tees up* Concierge conversations without violating the 12-month floor.
**RO Replacement (25 candidates):**
Lower urgency (RO filters degrade slowly), lower open rates (maintenance fatigue), and the CTA is transactional (order filters) vs. relationship-building. This is a **standing automated sequence** candidate, not a high-impact broadcast.
**Cold Lead Re-Engagement (1,000 subscribers, no engagement >60d):**
Massive audience, but **cold = low intent**. A re-engagement campaign here needs a **content-first hook** (e.g., "32,000 gallons of jet fuel leaked into Maryland water" angle) to reset the relationship before asking for a free water assessment. Recent Mailchimp data shows news-hook emails (jet fuel leak) got 0.4% open + 0.01% click. **the list is burned**. A cold re-engagement play needs a **multi-touch sequence** (3-5 emails over 2 weeks, ascending urgency), not a single broadcast. Recommend this as a **MAY project** (build the sequence), not this week's campaign.
**Lapsed Quotes (0 candidates this week):**
No audience. Skip.
---
**RECOMMENDATION: Send BOTH campaigns this week.**
- Referral push (Tuesday 10am) hits satisfied recent buyers with a cash incentive and zero friction.
- Annual service (Thursday 9am) hits a high-intent maintenance window and tees up Concierge upsells during service calls.
Combined expected revenue: **1 referral close (~$5k) + 8 service bookings ($1,200) + 2-3 Concierge conversions during service calls ($300-400 MRR) = $6,200 direct + $3,600 annualized Concierge value.**
